newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bull market comes roaring back at opening.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bull market comes roaring back at opening.

text.p: U.S. stocks roared higher at the opening on Friday, with the Dow industrials surging more than 30 points in the first few minutes of trading and the Nasdaq recovering all of its heavy losses from Thursday.
The Dow industrials were up 31.94 points to 6,474.45, or about a half percent. On Thursday the market revived on a late buy program but did not quite make up its earlier losses.

The Nasdaq Composite sailed up 10.7, or 0.84 percent, to 1,291.4, erasing steep losses on Thursday when it closed off 10.33 to 1,280.70. Technology stocks were slammed on Thursday on fears of poor holiday sales at computer retailers.

Some stocks which analysts had said suffered undeservedly in the technology sell-off recovered, including Dell Computer, which rose 1-1/2 to 52-3/4, and Gateway 2000, which rose 1-7/8 to 53. Compaq also jumped 1-1/8 to 73-1/2 in early trading.
The long bond was up 7/32 to yield 6.72 percent.
